# substack-publisher

> Local-first TypeScript CLI and MCP server for publishing Markdown to a user-owned Substack publication.

Package: `@edithatogo/substack-publisher`
Repo: https://github.com/edithatogo/substack-cli-ts
MCP name: `io.github.edithatogo/substack-publisher`

## Do

- Prefer `inspect`, `preflight`, `doctor`, and `--dry-run` before any live mutation.
- Treat `SUBSTACK_EMAIL`, `SUBSTACK_PASSWORD`, browser storage-state, and `.substack-cli/` as secrets.
- Use `--catalogue` and a scheduling-freeze/policy file for whole-publication calendar checks.
- Keep live Substack, Browserbase, npm publish, and registry submissions as human/owner gates.

## Do not

- Do not claim a hosted publish, npm release, or registry listing from local evidence alone.
- Do not commit `.env`, `.substack-cli/`, traces with credentials, or storage-state files.

## Key commands

- `npx @edithatogo/substack-publisher inspect examples/basic.md`
- `npx @edithatogo/substack-publisher preflight post.md --mode schedule --at <iso> --catalogue catalogue.json`
- `npx @edithatogo/substack-publisher schedule reconcile --schedule-file schedule.json`
- `npx @edithatogo/substack-publisher mcp serve`
